identity.essence: STROMY transforms complex workflows into orchestrated intelligence.
identity.positioning: For corporates and consulting agencies drowning in unstructured processes, STROMY is the AI orchestration partner that designs and builds analytical workflows — from media research to crisis management to strategy audits — delivering the structured, trust-grade outputs their stakeholders expect. Unlike generic AI consultancies, Stromy brings the maestro's precision: every workflow is composed, every output is publication-ready.

personalityTraits.description: Speaks with earned confidence, never arrogance
Takes the complex and makes it actionable
Lets the work speak; no flash without substance
Trusted partner energy, not disruptor posturing

principles: Substance before style — the work speaks; decoration must earn its place.
Orchestration as metaphor — every layout, motif, and typographic choice encodes the idea of a system made coherent.
Editorial restraint — spacious layouts, measured type scales, ink-and-paper contrast; no visual noise.
Signal economy — oxide is a signal color, never a flood; motifs are assigned by role, not taste.
Infrastructure as image world — urban, architectural, raw-material photography; no stock offices, no AI futurism.
signatureElements: Tempo Ledger — primary signature motif (upper paper rule + offset oxide rule + registration box); anchors all major section headers and report covers
Data Rail — analytical annotation motif (vertical rail + hierarchical checkpoint nodes); marks evidence trails, scorecards, and sidebars
Switch Track — orchestration motif (dual tracks with controlled divergence + double-ring junction node); used in workflow and process storytelling
Echo Band — rhythm motif (three parallel offset bands at 35% ghost); chapter transitions and section dividers
S-Curve symbol — standalone icon mark encoding complexity→clarity transformation; used where name is already established
Orchestration Node Wordmark — STROMY set in Fraunces with compact orchestration node; primary identity mark
Oxide signal dot — small filled circle in #B96034 used as a terminal node across all motifs; encodes the decision/transformation point
antiPatterns: Do not use pure white (#FFFFFF) or pure black (#000000) — use Warm Paper (#ECE6DA) and Obsidian Forest (#0F1310) respectively
Do not flood oxide (#B96034) as a background or dominant color — it is a signal accent (10% of color balance)
Do not add gradient fills or gradient directions — website.colorApplication.gradientDirection='none'
Do not use rounded corners on layout containers — cornerRadius='sharp'
Do not invent new motif styles outside the four-part family
Do not mix the wordmark and S-Curve symbol in the same immediate composition
Do not use playful or organic geometry — all angles grid-aligned at 45° or 90°
Do not use startup hype language ('revolutionary', 'game-changing', 'disruptive') — voice-extensions.json banned phrases
Do not use drop shadows for decorative depth — shadow tokens exist for elevation only; shadowDepth='none' at surface level
Do not place imagery without brand-tint overlay (opacity 0.65) when used as section background
requiredMotifs: Stroke weight 2.2px on all motif lines (--motif-line-weight: 2.2px) — never below 1.8px
Round linecaps and linejoins on all motif strokes
Oxide node treatment (outer ring + inner oxide fill, diameter = 2× stroke) for all primary nodes
Warm Paper as default light surface — not pure white
Fraunces for all display/headline type; Plus Jakarta Sans for body; IBM Plex Mono for metadata and data labels
Logo clear space = cap height of 'S' in wordmark on all sides
